name: Hohenauer
beschreibung: The holiday home Hohenauer is located on a quiet side street in Kufstein. The accommodation has several bedrooms, a living room and a fully equipped kitchen with stove and refrigerator. A private bathroom with shower and toilet is available. Amenities also include Wi-Fi and a parking space at the house. The surroundings are characterized by the nearby Festung Kufstein and the Inntal. Hiking trails and ski areas are easily reachable in the region. Guests can use the accommodation as a base for excursions. The holiday home is suitable for families or small travel groups.
